intervals.label: detector model measurements
intervals.note: Year precision: a 400 l test model was used first; the end is the year the full-scale detector replaced it ("The model of the detector was replaced with the full-scale detector in 2016").
intervals.quote: The experiment Neutrino-4 had started in 2014 with a detector model and then was continued with a full-scale detector in 2016 - 2021.

intervals.label: full-scale detector data taking
intervals.note: Start is month precision from the 2020 analysis paper; the end is year precision from the PRD abstract ("2016 - 2021"). The reactor-on measurements ran until June 2019; background measurements followed from June 2019 to January 2020 and the 2021 paper reports data to 2021.
intervals.quote: The measurements with reactor under operation have started in June 2016 and were continued till June 2019, when reactor was stopped for renovation.

intervals.label: completed
intervals.note: Terminal event at the end of the stated 2016-2021 period; the same paper announces plans for an improved or completely new setup, whose construction was not found in the sources.
intervals.quote: The experiment Neutrino-4 had started in 2014 with a detector model and then was continued with a full-scale detector in 2016 - 2021.

placements.note: Campus-grade site point (the RIAR site); see the site record.
placements.quote: The experiment has been carried out on the SM-3 reactor having a compact active zone

sensitive_volume.quote: The total volume of the scintillator is 1.8 m3.

summary.plain: A tank holding 1.8 cubic metres of gadolinium-doped liquid scintillator in 50 sections, with photomultiplier tubes and shielding, that rolls on rails to different distances from the reactor.
summary.technical: Inner vessel divided into 10 rows x 5 sections (0.225 x 0.225 x 0.85 m^3) filled with 0.1 % Gd liquid scintillator (1.8 m^3 total), PMT readout, passive and active (muon veto) shielding; movable on rails to measure 6-12 m from the core.

technology.quote: This detector is also filled with liquid scintillator with gadolinium concentration 0.1%. The detector inner vessel is divided into 50 sections
technology.value: Gd-doped (0.1 %) liquid-scintillator antineutrino detector divided into 50 sections, movable on rails, with active muon veto
